# ligo_platforms (Data Source)

A platform: an instance of a platform plugin, with its identity provider and secret store.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ligo_platforms" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) At most this many items (default 1000, at most 10000). More is an error, not a truncation: narrow the filters or raise the limit.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) What was found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_source_trust_domains` (List of String) The trust domains of the sources that may use it.
- `description` (String) What it is.
- `display_name` (String) A name for people.
- `identity_provider` (String) The identity provider instance it uses.
- `jurisdiction` (String) The jurisdiction.
- `name` (String) The name.
- `quarantined` (Boolean) Whether ligo isolated it after repeated failures.
- `realm` (String) The realm.
- `revision` (Number) The revision.
- `secret_store` (String) The secret store instance it uses.
- `serving` (Boolean) Whether its plugin is healthy.
- `target_jurisdictions` (List of String) The jurisdictions its targets may have.
